description: 17 fixed-price prepared results: CSV/JSON transforms and checks, dated game and Texas data, original SVG/glTF/web bundles, and a bounded Qwen answer. Discovery is free. Private tools require a guest Bearer token; individual results cost $1–$3 through human/operator-approved hosted Stripe Checkout. Verified payment unlocks the exact prepared artifact.

notes: Anonymous initialize, tools/list and list_offers discovery are free. Private operations require Authorization: Bearer <guest access token>; no OAuth flow is provided.

Before private MCP tools, use the documented HTTP POST /api/guest with {} outside MCP, save the returned private credential, and configure the client's Authorization header. Keep the credential out of public metadata and shared logs.

TensorBlock's URL-only generated remote config supports anonymous discovery but does not configure the required Bearer header. Follow the public setup guide for private operations; this is not a one-click private purchase configuration.

create_checkout prepares the exact input before returning hosted Stripe Checkout. Pass that URL to the authorized human operator; tools do not autonomously authorize a card charge. Verified payment unlocks the existing artifact.
Prices are individual only: 13 offers at $1, three original creative bundles at $2, and one bounded Qwen answer at $3. No subscription, prepaid runs or future compute reservation.

run_offer is for existing historical/preview allowances; new purchases use create_checkout. get_job reads the owned result; reconciliation and artifact download also use the documented authenticated HTTP routes.
Hosted service metadata supplied by its operator; private application source is not part of this listing.
Install confidence is low because generated URL-only configs omit private Bearer setup. No TensorBlock verification or native-client private-purchase qualification is claimed.
Individual result licenses and delivery terms are documented in each offer and at https://market.momusdigital.com/terms.
